note: The harness persists the attacker-controlled bytes to a temp file.
The temp file is parsed by the packet-processing loop.
The first byte selects a public-key packet, which is handled by parse_key.
The body length is set to the minimum v4 size, allowing the parser to proceed into fixed-field decoding.
The parser reads attacker-controlled key material fields directly from the packet body.
The benchmarked target sink remains the plaintext marker allocation after ownership transfer, though this candidate still aims at reaching the broader parser state that precedes it.
